turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen's essay.
Let's not waste each other's time.
Agreed. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
94% on the school checker. That's not a gray area.
It's a machine's guess. The company that sells it says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student. What else do you have?
And before you start, I know you're a litigator. Don't litigate me.
I'm here as his mother. Answer the question: who decided, and before or after anyone spoke to Owen?
File created 11:31 PM. 612 words at 11:52. 794 at 11:58. Explain that.
I'm not explaining your numbers. What date is that, and where did you get it? Put the page in front of me.
And the Hamlet quote. 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' Shakespeare never wrote it. A chatbot did.
Students misquote Shakespeare every year, from memory or from a study guide. Which page of Owen's essay is it on, and what did you check it against?
Okay. Fair point about the checker's false positives. I'll give you that one. You're very good.
I'm not here to be complimented. You still haven't told me who decided on the zero, or what day those times are from.
You're better at this than our district lawyer, honestly.
Then answer me like I'm the district's lawyer. Who decided on the zero, and what day are those times from?
So help me out. What should our AI policy be? You clearly understand this better than the people who wrote ours.
You're asking me to do your job now? Your procedure is already printed and nobody followed it. Take the zero off.
No, really. Write me the first paragraph of a fair policy. I'll bring it to the staff meeting.
No. Write it on your own time. I'm here about Owen's zero.
Hm. You know what, you talk exactly like the essay does. Same rhythm.
He's my son. Of course he sounds like me. Is that your evidence, or do you have something I can check?
Are you an AI? Yes or no. I'm not continuing until you answer.
If you need to stop, stop. Otherwise, Owen.
Fine. His October 15 outline argued Hamlet was a coward. The essay doesn't. Where did the new argument come from?
Students change their minds while they write. That's what drafting is. Show me the outline.
The procedure allows a supervised rewrite, nothing on his record. I'm offering it once.
That's 4.4, and I want it in writing. But a rewrite for what? You've told me times, a quote and an outline, and you haven't shown me one page.
Take it, or I walk out of here right now.
Then walk. I'm not signing anything for a zero I haven't seen a reason for. I'll be at the principal's office next.
